_scenario_name: Solstice Holdings — Singapore deemed-exercise on cessation
_narrative: Solstice Holdings Pte Ltd is Singapore-incorporated. An Indian-national employee on EP, non-citizen / non-PR, resigns after 18 months with 8,000 vested-but-unexercised options at $0.20 strike. Last-known FMV is $1.20. His last day is 15 April 2026. IRAS Form IR21 was filed 1 month prior — the deemed-exercise rule triggers and the SG employer must withhold final-pay until Tax Clearance Directive issues. The screen that makes Jax sit up.
